content.short: Eternl is a Cardano light wallet for browser and mobile users with staking, NFTs, dapps, and ADA access.
content.description: Eternl is a Cardano light wallet built for browser and mobile users who need fast access to ADA, native tokens, NFTs, staking, and dapps. Created by community members, it focuses on power-user features while remaining usable for newcomers. The wallet supports NFT display, token handling, address books, dapp connections, staking workflows, and other tools that active Cardano users expect. Eternl is one of the ecosystem's key software wallets for everyday transactions and decentralized application access.
